title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo ngedivayisi yakho, ukulungise. Kumahhala, kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi ngawe kunalokho okucabangayo. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikubonisa lokho ezingakubona, ukuthi obani abangakubuka, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani, ngamazwi alula.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Umkhondo wedijithali: ngokuthepha kanye kuhlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo olungakufunda mayelana nomkhondo wedivayisi yakho.
2. Izinhlelo ezibucayi: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokuthandana, ezokholo, ezempilo noma ze-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungathini ngawe.
3. Abalandeleli: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zivale idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo ezinezimvume zezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingaphezu kweyodwa kulezi ziyamakwa, ngoba yilokho izinhlelo zokubheka ezikwenzayo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elibonisa ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera nombhobho.
4. Ukuhlola: landela izinyathelo ezilula njengezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa kabusha kwamasonto onke kanye nokuhlolwa kobumfihlo kwamaphasiwedi avunyelwe, bese ubheka Izilungiselelo zakho endaweni ngayinye ngesikhathi, uhoxise izimvume zezinhlelo zokusebenza ongafuni ukuzinikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA KUKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sobumfihlo, kokungama-100, sihlanganisa lokhu kuhlola okune ndawonye. Uma siphezulu kungcono kakhulu, futhi siyakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thepha okuthi "Lungisa nami" bese uhlelo luhamba nawe ekulungiseni ngakunye, ngakunye ngesikhathi, likuvulele Izilungiselelo ezifanele. Bese uhlola futhi ubone isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUZOLILE FUTHI KUTHEMBEKILE
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekwa, okuphuzi kufanele ukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholakele ngamazwi acacile: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa wokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani.
• Izinhlelo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho azimakwa, futhi izinhlelo zokulawula zabazali noma ezomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho ngempela.
• Impendulo ethembekile ethi "ngu-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongakulungisa lokhu" lapho kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma uthanda.

KUBONAKALA NANGESIKHATHI USUSUSA UHLELO
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala ifana noma ngabe uyazisusa uphinde uzifake kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasefekthri kuphela okungayishintsha.

KUKLANYELWE UBUMFIHLO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo alukwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho-ke akukho okuphuma kudivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho ukuthenga, akukho ukubhalisa.
• Umthombo ovulekile, ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukuhlola ukuthi lusebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomsizi ongumseshi: usekhasini ngalinye futhi unamathiphu uma umthepha.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo ezibeka ubumfihlo phambili.
releaseNotes:
• Amazwi acacile eKuhloleni.
Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kwamaphutha ajwayelekile nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kahle.
